verdict.rationale: Braintrust is a SaaS platform that stores customer AI traces and datasets, so a no-training policy or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement or control about excluding customer data from model training. Self-hosting covers data residency and infrastructure control, which is an adjacent capability and not a training-use guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
